PcosSkinHair.6: I-PCOS ingabangela izinguquko ezibonakalayo esikhumbeni, ezinweleni zomzimba noma ezinweleni zekhanda. Ukuqonda lapho zivela khona kwenza kube lula ukuzibona nokwazi ukuthi yimaphi amasu angacatshangelwa.
PcosSkinHair.7: Lezi zimpawu ziyajwayeleka, kodwa ngokwazo azidingeki futhi azanele ukuxilonga i-PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.19: I-PCOS ingaba nokukhiqizwa noma umsebenzi owandayo wama-androgen, amahomoni akhona ngokwemvelo nasezinsikazini. Uma umphumela wawo ukhulu kakhulu, angathinta izindlala zamafutha, ama-follicle ezinwele, nomjikelezo wokukhula kwezinwele.
PcosSkinHair.20: Leli homoni lingachaza kakhulu ukuvela kwe-acne eqhubekayo, ukukhula kwezinwele okwandayo, noma, kwabanye besifazane, ukuncipha kwezinwele.
PcosSkinHair.22: Izimpawu ezibonakalayo azibonisi ngempela ukuthi i-PCOS inzima kangakanani. Owesifazane oyedwa angaba nezimpawu eziningana ezibonakalayo, kanti omunye angaba nazo ezimbalwa noma angabi nazo nhlobo.
PcosSkinHair.23: I-acne ehlobene nezinguquko zamahomoni ingavela noma iqhubeke ngemva kobuntwana. Ivame ukuthinta ikhanda lenhlathi, umhlathi, izihlathi eziphansi, noma kwesinye isikhathi intamo.
PcosSkinHair.24: Kwabanye abantu, amabhaka ajulile, ayabuhlungu futhi ayaphinda avele. Angashiya namabala noma izibazi uma ekhlinywa noma uma evuvukele kakhulu.
PcosSkinHair.28: I-acne evuka ngezikhathi eziphinda zilandele izinguquko zamahomoni
PcosSkinHair.29: Amabala noma izibazi eziqhubeka ngemva kokuvuka kwe-acne
PcosSkinHair.30: I-hirsutism ikhomba ukukhula kwezinwele ezijiyile ezindaweni ezingajwayele ukuthinteka kwabesifazane. Endabeni ye-PCOS, kungahlobana nomthelela wama-androgen ezinweleni.
PcosSkinHair.31: Izindawo ezithinteka kakhulu yilezi: ikhanda lenhlathi, indebe engenhla, isifuba, isisu, noma umhlane. Ukukhula kwezinwele kuhluka kakhulu phakathi kwabantu.
PcosSkinHair.34: Izinwele ezilukhuni kakhulu enhlathini noma endebeni engenhla
PcosSkinHair.35: Izinwele ezingakhula esifubeni, esiswini noma emhlane
PcosSkinHair.36: Ukuncipha kancane kancane kwezinwele phezulu ekhanda
PcosSkinHair.38: Ukukhula kwezinwele kuncike nasezimbangeni zofuzo nezomuntu ngamunye. Ukukhula kwezinwele okubonakalayo akusho ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuthi i-PCOS ikhona.
PcosSkinHair.39: Abanye besifazane abane-PCOS baphawula nokuncipha kobuningi bezinwele. Ukuncipha kungabonakala kakhulu phezulu ekhanda noma emgqeni ohlukanisa izinwele phakathi.
PcosSkinHair.40: Lokhu kungenzeka kancane kancane. Kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa ukuwa kwezinwele okuhlobene namahomoni neminye imbangela engaba khona, njengokweswela, inkinga ye-thyroid, imithi ethile, noma isikhathi sokucindezeleka okukhulu.
PcosSkinHair.42: Ukuwa kwezinwele okukhulu, okusheshayo noma okungajwayelekile kudinga ukuhlolwa ngudokotela ukuze kutholakale imbangela.
PcosSkinHair.43: Inqubo elula nehlala njalo imvamisa ingcono kunokufaka imikhiqizo eminingi. Inhloso ukuhlanza, ukufaka umswakama nokuvikela isikhumba, kuyilapho kugwenywa konke okungaqhubekisa ukucasuka.
PcosSkinHair.44: Inqubo yokunakekela isikhumba ethambile futhi ehlala njalo
PcosSkinHair.48: Uma izinwele ziba mncane, kungasiza ukunciphisa ingcindezi ephindaphindiwe kuzo: ukushisa ngokweqile, izinwele ezibotshwe ngokuqinile kakhulu, noma ukwelashwa ngamakhemikhali njalo.
PcosSkinHair.49: Ukubonana nodokotela wesikhumba kungaba wusizo uma ubuningi bezinwele buqhubeka nokuncipha, ukuze kutholakale imbangela futhi kuxoxwe ngokwelashwa okukhona.
PcosSkinHair.51: Khetha imikhiqizo ethambile futhi ugweme ukufaka izindlela eziningi zokwelapha ezicasulayo
PcosSkinHair.52: Hlanza isikhumba ngaphandle kokusomisa ngokweqile, ekuseni nakusihlwa uma kudingeka
PcosSkinHair.53: Sebenzisa ukuvikelwa elangeni uma isikhumba sivulekile
PcosSkinHair.54: Gwema ukukhlinya amabhaka ukuze unciphise amabala nezibazi
PcosSkinHair.55: Cela ukweluleka kochwepheshe uma izimpawu ziqhubeka noma ziba zimbi kakhulu
PcosSkinHair.56: Ukwelashwa kuncike ezimpawini, ukuthi zinamandla kangakanani, umthelela wazo empilweni yansuku zonke, nezinhloso zowesifazane ngamunye. Kungasiza ukusebenza ezindleleni eziningana kunokufuna isisombululo esisodwa.
PcosSkinHair.58: Inqubo efanele nokweluleka kodokotela wesikhumba uma kudingeka.
PcosSkinHair.60: Izixazululo zokuzinga noma zezokwelapha kuye ngesimo.
PcosSkinHair.65: Kuhle ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo uma i-acne iqhubeka noma iba buhlungu, uma izinwele zikhula ngokushesha, uma izinwele zincipha kakhulu, noma uma lezi zinguquko zihambisana nemijikelezo engahleliwe kakhulu.
PcosSkinHair.66: Udokotela wesikhumba angaphatha izimpawu zesikhumba nezezinwele. Udokotela wabesifazane (gynecologist) noma omunye uchwepheshe ofanelekile angaphinda ahlole isimo samahomoni nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimpawu ezingaba khona ze-PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.68: Ukukhula kwezinwele okusheshayo nokukhulu, ukuwa kwezinwele ngokuzumayo, noma izinguquko zamahomoni ezingajwayelekile kudinga ukweluleka kwezokwelapha.
PcosSkinHair.69: Ukuba ne-acne akusho ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuthi unayo i-PCOS
PcosSkinHair.70: Ukukhula kwezinwele okubonakalayo akuhlobene nje namahomoni kuphela
PcosSkinHair.71: I-PCOS ingathinta abesifazane abanobukhulu bomzimba bonke
PcosSkinHair.72: Izimpawu zingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi azifani kowesifazane ngamunye
PcosSkinHair.73: Izimpawu ezibonakalayo ze-PCOS zingacasula, kodwa azichazi ubufazi bakho, ukubaluleka kwakho, noma ukuhlanzeka kwakho.
PcosSkinHair.75: I-PCOS ingathinta isikhumba, izinwele zomzimba nezinwele zekhanda.
PcosSkinHair.79: Usizo lwezokwelapha lungakusiza ukukhetha indlela efanele wena.
PcosSkinHair.81: I-acne, ukukhula kwezinwele ngokweqile, noma ukuwa kwezinwele kungaba yizimpawu ze-PCOS, kodwa akugwemeki. Indlela eyenzelwe wena ingakusiza ukuphatha izimpawu kangcono futhi uzizwe ukhululekile nsuku zonke.
PcosSkinHair.82: Lesi sihloko siyolwazi kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yokubonana nodokotela, ukuxilongwa, noma ukwelashwa okwenzelwe wena.
PcosSkinHair.83: Isikhumba, izinwele nezimpawu ezibonakalayo ze-PCOS — AWA

PerineumStrengthening.6: Ngemva kokukhulelwa nokubeletha, i-pelvic floor idinga isikhathi ukuze iphile kabusha. Imisebenzi elula, ejwayelekile neqhubekayo ingakusiza ubuyele emandleni, ekulawuleni nasekuzethembeni, ngaphandle kokushisekela ukusheshisa izinto.
PerineumStrengthening.18: Ukuqinisa i-pelvic floor ngemva kokubeletha — AWA
PerineumStrengthening.20: I-perineum, ebizwa nangokuthi i-pelvic floor, yiqembu lemisipha esekeleni lesiphundu. Isiza ekulawuleni isinyi nesigaxa futhi isekela izitho zesiphundu.
PerineumStrengthening.21: Ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, le misipha kufanele iphathe isisindo esengeziwe izinyanga eziningana. Icindezelwa kakhulu nangesikhathi sokubeletha.
PerineumStrengthening.23: I-pelvic floor ibamba iqhaza emisebenzini eminingana yansuku zonke: ukubamba umchamo nendle, ukulawula umoya, ukusekela izitho zesiphundu, nokubamba iqhaza kwezinye izindlela zocansi.
PerineumStrengthening.25: Ukuqinisa kancane kancane futhi ngendlela efanele kungasiza ukuthuthukisa ukulawula nokusekela kwe-pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.28: I-pelvic floor ibamba iqhaza ekulawuleni isinye. Ukuyiqinisa kancane kancane kungasiza ukunciphisa ukuvuza komchamo okuthile.
PerineumStrengthening.31: Le misipha isiza nasekulawuleni umoya nendle futhi inikela ekusekeleni izitho zesiphundu.
PerineumStrengthening.34: I-pelvic floor yakha isisekelo semisipha esiqinisekile esisiza ukusekela isinye, ibhikawozi namathumbu.
PerineumStrengthening.37: Ukuvivinya okufanele kungakusiza futhi ube nokuqaphela nokulawula kangcono kule ndawo.
PerineumStrengthening.39: Ukukhulelwa kubeka ingcindezi eyengeziwe kancane kancane ku-pelvic floor. Ukubeletha ngomhlandla kungase kuyelule kakhulu imisipha nezicubu kule ndawo.
PerineumStrengthening.40: Ukubeletha ngokuhlinzwa (cesarean) nakho akuyisindisi ngokuphelele i-pelvic floor: ukukhulelwa ngokwakho kuhlala kuyisikhathi esibalulekile kule misipha.
PerineumStrengthening.41: Ngemva kokubeletha, ngakho-ke kujwayelekile ukuthi ukuphila kabusha kuthathe isikhathi. Abanye besifazane cishe abazwa zimpawu, kanti abanye bangaphawula ukuvuza, umuzwa wokusinda, noma ukwehla kokulawula imisipha.
PerineumStrengthening.43: Uhlobo lokubeletha, ukuklebhuka noma i-episiotomy, ubuhlungu, nesimo sakho jikelele ngemva kokubeletha konke kungathinta ukuphila kabusha.
PerineumStrengthening.45: Ngemva kokubeletha okungenazinkinga, ukuncipha okuthambile kwe-pelvic floor imvamisa kungaqalwa kabusha kancane kancane. Kuhlala kubalulekile ukuvumelanisa imisebenzi nesimo sakho nokucela ukweluleka uma ube nenkinga, ubuhlungu obukhulu, noma inqubo ethile.
PerineumStrengthening.46: Uma unompompi womchamo, ezinye izincomo ziphakamisa ukulinda kuze kukhishwe futhi ukuchama okujwayelekile kubuyele ngaphambi kokuqala imisebenzi ye-perineum.
PerineumStrengthening.48: Ubuhlungu obukhulu, izimpawu ezimbi kakhulu, inxeba eliphola kabi, noma yikuphi okukukhathazayo kudinga ukweluleka komzali (umbelethisi), udokotela, noma uchwepheshe wokuvivinya.
PerineumStrengthening.50: Ukuze uqaphele lo mnyakazo, cabanga ukuthi uzama ukubamba umoya nesifiso sokuchama ngasikhathi sinye. Lokho okufunayo umuzwa wokuncipha nokuhlehlisa phakathi.
PerineumStrengthening.51: Inhloso akukhona ukuqinisa umzimba wonke. Amanqina, amathanga nesisu kufanele kuhlale kuthambile kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kuyilapho ukuphefumula kuqhubeka kujwayelekile.
PerineumStrengthening.61: Ngemva kokuncipha ngakunye, vumela imisipha iphumule ngokuphelele. Ukuvivinya okuhle akusho ukugcina i-perineum iqinile usuku lonke.
PerineumStrengthening.63: Ekuqaleni, okubaluleke kakhulu ukufunda ukuhlonza imisipha nokwenza umnyakazo kahle. Ukuhlala njalo kubalulekile kunamandla.
PerineumStrengthening.65: Ncipha kancane i-pelvic floor, bese ugcina ukuncipha imizuzwana embalwa ngaphandle kokubamba umoya. Bese ukhulula ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuphinda.
PerineumStrengthening.67: Uma umnyakazo usuwazi kahle, ungangeza ukuncipha okuncane okusheshayo. Kusiza ukuzijwayeza ukuncipha ngokushesha lapho ingcindezi yesisu ikhula, isibonelo ngaphambi kokukhwehlela noma ukuthimula.
PerineumStrengthening.81: Ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi nesihloko esivele sisosukwini lwakho kungakusiza ukuhlala njalo: ngemva kokuncelisa, ngemva kokuxubha amazinyo, noma ngesinye isikhathi esikufanelayo.
PerineumStrengthening.83: Imisebenzi ye-perineum ingabonakala ilula, kodwa kulula ukusebenzisa eminye imisipha esikhundleni noma ukuphoqa ngokweqile.
PerineumStrengthening.84: Ukuqinisa amanqina noma amathanga esikhundleni se-pelvic floor
PerineumStrengthening.86: Ukugcina imisipha ncipha njalo ngaphandle kokuyiyekela iphumule
PerineumStrengthening.87: Ukwenza imisebenzi izinsuku ezimbalwa kuphela bese uyayeka
PerineumStrengthening.88: Ukumisa ngamabomu umchamo ukuze uhlole ukuncipha
PerineumStrengthening.90: Akunconywa ukuzivivinya ngokumisa umchamo ngamabomu. Le ndlela ayiyivivinyi kahle i-perineum futhi ingaphazamisa umsebenzi ojwayelekile wesinye.
PerineumStrengthening.91: Yiziphi izimpawu ezifanele zikuthumele ukubonana nodokotela?
PerineumStrengthening.92: Ukuvuza okuncane noma umuzwa ongajwayelekile kungavela ngemva kokubeletha. Kodwa akufanele kunganakwa uma kuqhubeka, kubi kakhulu, noma kuphazamisa impilo yakho yansuku zonke.
PerineumStrengthening.93: Ukuvuza komchamo uma ukhwehlela, uthimula, uhleka noma uphokophela
PerineumStrengthening.94: Umuzwa wokusinda noma wengcindezi ezansi esiphundwini
PerineumStrengthening.95: Umuzwa wokuthi isigaxa noma okuthile kuyehla emacansini
PerineumStrengthening.98: Ubuhlungu ngesikhathi noma ngemva kobuhlobo bocansi
PerineumStrengthening.99: Ubunzima bokuhlonza noma bokuncipha kahle kwemisipha ye-perineum
PerineumStrengthening.101: Umbelethisi, udokotela, noma i-physiotherapist ekhethekile ekuvivinyeni i-pelvic floor angahlola umsebenzi wemisipha futhi aphakamise uhlelo olufanele.
PerineumStrengthening.102: Nakuba kuklebhukile, kwenziwe i-episiotomy, noma kwahlinzwa (cesarean)?
PerineumStrengthening.103: Ukuklebhuka noma i-episiotomy kudinga ukunakekelwa okukhethekile ngesikhathi sokuphola. Ukubuyela emisebenzini kufanele kucabangele ubuhlungu, isimo sesibazi, nesiqondiso esinikeziwe ngemva kokubeletha.
PerineumStrengthening.104: Ngemva kokubeletha ngokuhlinzwa, ukuphila kabusha kuhilela nodonga lwesisu nesibazi. Noma ngabe ukubeletha kwakungeyona ngomhlandla, ukukhulelwa ngokwakho kwabeka ingcindezi ku-pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.106: Uma kuklebhuke kakhulu, kunobuhlungu, izimpawu zomchamo noma zamathumbu, noma ubunzima obuqhubekayo, ukuhlolwa ngochwepheshe wezempilo kungaba wusizo kakhulu.
PerineumStrengthening.108: Ukubuyela ekunyakazeni ngemva kokubeletha kufanele kube kancane kancane. Ukuhamba nokunyakaza okuthambile imvamisa kungaqalwa kabusha ngokuya ngendlela ozizwa ngayo, kanti imisebenzi enomthelela omkhulu idinga ukuqapha okwengeziwe.
PerineumStrengthening.109: Ngaphambi kokuqala ukugijima, ukugxuma, noma ukuzivivinya okunzima kakhulu, kungcono ukuhlola ukuphila kabusha kwe-pelvic floor futhi ucabangele nanoma yiziphi izimpawu.
PerineumStrengthening.111: Ukuvuza, umuzwa wokusinda, noma ubuhlungu ngesikhathi noma ngemva kokuzivivinya kuyizimpawu zokuthi kufanele wehlise isivinini futhi ucele ukweluleka ngaphambi kokukhulisa amandla.
PerineumStrengthening.113: Ukuvivinya i-pelvic floor nomzali (umbelethisi) noma i-physiotherapist kungaba wusizo uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi uncipha kahle, uma izimpawu zakho ziqhubeka, noma uma ufuna ukubuyela emisebenzini ethile yomzimba ngokuzethemba.
PerineumStrengthening.115: Ingabe izimpawu zami ziyahambisana nokuphela kwamandla kwe-pelvic floor?
PerineumStrengthening.118: Ngingabuyela ekugijimeni, ezemidlalo, noma ekuzivivinyeni okunomthelela omkhulu?
PerineumStrengthening.120: Ingabe isibazi sami, ukuklebhuka, noma ukuhlinzwa (cesarean) kudinga ukuqapha okukhethekile?
PerineumStrengthening.122: Ukubona uchwepheshe akusho ngempela ukuthi kukhona okungalungile. Isikhathi esisodwa singasiza nje ukuhlola indlela yakho, ukuhlola ukuphila kabusha kwakho, nokufunda ukuqhubeka kahle.
PerineumStrengthening.124: Ngemva kokubeletha, kujwayelekile ukungabuyeli masisha emizweni noma emandleni emisipha owayenayo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa.
PerineumStrengthening.125: Inhloso akukhona ukwenza ukuncipha okuningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Kumayelana nokubuyisa kancane kancane ukuvumelana okuhle phakathi kokuncipha nokuphumula, bese uba nokusebenzisa le misipha ngokwemvelo emisebenzini yansuku zonke.
PerineumStrengthening.126: Inqubekela phambili encane iyinqubekela phambili ngempela
PerineumStrengthening.127: Ukuqaphela kangcono umnyakazo, imizuzwana embalwa eyengeziwe yokuncipha, noma ukwehla kokuvuza kuyizimpawu ezikhuthazayo kakade.
PerineumStrengthening.130: Ukukhulelwa nokubeletha kubeka ingcindezi enkulu ku-pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.131: Ukuphila kabusha kancane kancane kujwayelekile ngemva kokubeletha.
PerineumStrengthening.132: Imisebenzi kufanele ibeke phambili ikhwalithi yomnyakazo kunamandla.
PerineumStrengthening.134: Ukuvuza komchamo, ukusinda, noma ubuhlungu obuqhubekayo kudinga umbono wochwepheshe.
PerineumStrengthening.135: Ukuvivinya nomzali (umbelethisi) noma i-physiotherapist kungakusiza ubuyele ekulawuleni kangcono.
PerineumStrengthening.136: Ukubuyela ezemidlalo kufanele kube kancane kancane, ikakhulukazi emisebenzini enomthelela omkhulu.
PerineumStrengthening.138: Ngemva kokubeletha, umzimba wakho wadlula ezinguqukweni eziningi. I-perineum ifanele ukunakwa ngokufanayo nomzimba wonke: kancane kancane, njalo, futhi ngaphandle kwengcindezi.
PerineumStrengthening.139: Lesi sihloko siyolwazi kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esenzelwe wena. Uma unobuhlungu, izimpawu eziqhubekayo, noma uthintwa yinoma yikuphi mayelana nokuphila kabusha kwakho, cela ukweluleka kochwepheshe wezempilo.

PeriodPain.6: Ukushisa, ukunyakaza okuthambile, ukudla: imikhuba ekhulula ngempela.
PeriodPain.12: Ukuqunjelwa kuvela ekuncipheni kwesibeletho okusiza ukukhipha ungqimba lwesibeletho. Kubangelwa ama-prostaglandin. Umzimba ngamunye uphendula ngendlela ehlukile.
PeriodPain.14: Ubuhlungu bungahluka kusuka emjikelezweni oya komunye futhi abuhlali bufana njalo.
PeriodPain.16: Isikhwama samanzi ashisayo esiswini sakho esiphansi singadambisa imisipha.
PeriodPain.18: I-yoga, ukwelula nokuhamba okulula kunciphisa ukuqina komzimba.
PeriodPain.22: Ukuphuza amanzi anele kusiza ukunciphisa ukuvuvukala kwesisu.
PeriodPain.24: Ukuthinta isisu sakho esiphansi ngokuzungeza kukusiza uphumule.
PeriodPain.25: Uma ubuhlungu bukuvimbela ukuphila kahle njalo ngenyanga naphezu kwalezi zixazululo, kubalulekile ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo.
PeriodPain.27: Ubuhlungu obukhulu kakhulu, ukopha okukhulu, ukukhathala okukhulu, noma izimpawu ezingajwayelekile.
PeriodPain.28: Fudumeza umzimba wakho kancane uma uvuka
PeriodPain.31: Landelela umjikelezo wakho ukuze uqonde kangcono ubuhlungu bakho

Pms.4: I-PMS ithinta cishe abesifazane abayisi-8 kwabayi-10. Ukukhathala, ukucasuka, ukuvuvukala kwesisu… Ukuqonda izimbangela zayo nokulandela imikhuba efanele kungasithuthukisa kakhulu lesi sikhathi senyanga.
Pms.11: Isifo sangaphambi kwesikhathi sihlanganisa izimpawu zomzimba nezemizwa ezivame ukuvela izinsuku ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 ngaphambi kwesikhathi sakho futhi zinyamalale ekuqaleni komjikelezo wokuya esikhathini.
Pms.13: Izimpawu zivela ngaphambi kwesikhathi sakho futhi imvamisa ziyaphela uma siqala.
Pms.15: Amandla nohlobo lwezimpawu kungahluka kakhulu phakathi kwabesifazane, nasemjikelezweni oya komunye.
Pms.17: Ukucasuka, ukukhathazeka, ukuzwa ubuhlungu enhliziyweni, ukushintshashintsha kwemizwa
Pms.19: Ukuvuvukala kwesisu, ubuhlungu, ukukhathala, ikhanda elihlungu
Pms.21: Isifiso sezinto ezimnandi, izinguquko ekudleni, ukukhathala
Pms.23: Ubunzima bokulala noma ukulala okungaphumuli kahle
Pms.24: Ukushintshashintsha kwamahomoni, ikakhulukazi i-progesterone ne-estrogen, kuthinta ama-neurotransmitter obuchopho (i-serotonin, i-dopamine), okungachaza izimpawu zemizwa nezomzimba ze-PMS.
Pms.26: Ukushintshashintsha kwamahomoni kungathinta isimo sengqondo, amandla, ukulala nemizwa ethile yomzimba.
Pms.28: Ukuphuza amanzi anele kusiza ukunciphisa ukuvuvukala kwesisu.
Pms.30: Khetha ukudla okunothile nge-magnesium, ama-omega-3 namavithamini e-B.
Pms.32: Ukuzivivinya komzimba kukhipha ama-endorphin futhi kunciphisa ukucindezeleka.
Pms.34: Ukuvivinya ukuphefumula, ukucabanga ngokuthula, ukubhala ijenali… Thola lokho okukusebenzela.
Pms.38: Uma izimpawu zinamandla kakhulu futhi zithinta impilo yakho yansuku zonke, kungaba yi-premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). Ungangabazi ukubonana nochwepheshe wezempilo.
Pms.39: Isifo sangaphambi kwesikhathi (PMS): ukusiqonda kangcono — AWA

PostpartumPeriodReturn.1:
Ukubuya kwesikhathi ngemva kokubeletha,
okufanele ukulindele
PostpartumPeriodReturn.4: Ngemva kokubeletha, ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho kungathatha isikhathi. Isikhathi siyahluka ngokuya ngokuncelisa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, futhi umuntu ngamunye angase aphathe lesi sikhathi ngendlela ehlukile.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.5: Ukubuya kwesikhathi ngemva kokubeletha, okufanele ukulindele — AWA
PostpartumPeriodReturn.7: “Ukubuya kwesikhathi” kusho ukuthi isikhathi sakho siyabuya ngemva kokubeletha. Umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini awubuyeli ngokushesha ekuhambeni kwawo okujwayelekile.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.9: Ayikho ingxenye yesikhathi esisodwa esisebenza kubo bonke.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.11: Isikhathi sincike kakhulu ekuncelisweni. Uma ungancelisi, isikhathi sakho imvamisa singabuya cishe emasontweni angu-6 kuya kwangu-8. Uma uncelisa kuphela ngobisi lwebele, singalibaziseka izinyanga eziningana.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.13: Imvamisa cishe emasontweni angu-6 kuya kwangu-8.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.17: Umjikelezo ubuya kancane kancane ngemva kokubeletha. Ukuncelisa kungathinta ukuthi isikhathi sakho sibuya nini.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.21: Umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini umiswa okwesikhashana ngemva kokubeletha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.23: Umzimba uphila kabusha kancane kancane futhi amazinga amahomoni ayashintsha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.25: Ukuncelisa kungalibazisa ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho, kodwa umphumela wako uyahluka kumuntu nomuntu.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.27: Isikhathi sakho sokuqala singabuya ngemva kwamasonto ambalwa noma izinyanga eziningana.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.29: Imijikelezo ingase ingahleleki ngaphambi kokuba ibuyele kancane kancane ekuhambeni kwayo okujwayelekile.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.30: Akukho ingxenye yesikhathi efanayo kubo bonke. Ukubuya kwesikhathi sakho kungahluka kumuntu nomuntu, ikakhulukazi ngokuya ngokuncelisa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.32: Uma isikhathi sakho sibuya, imijikelezo yokuqala ingase ihluke kuleyo yangaphambi kokukhulelwa. Ikakhulukazi, ingase ingahleleki ekuqaleni.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.34: Umjikelezo ungathatha isikhathi ukuze ubuyele ekuhambeni okujwayelekile.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.36: Ukugeleza kungase kuhluke kulokho obukubona ngaphambi kokukhulelwa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.38: Ukulandelela okulula kukusiza ubone kangcono indlela umjikelezo wakho ushintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.42: Bona kancane kancane isikhathi esiphakathi kwemijikelezo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.44: Qaphela nje noma yiziphi izinguquko uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okujwayelekile kuwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.46: Uma kukhona okubonakala kungajwayelekile, kuqhubeka, noma kukukhathaza, cela ukweluleka kochwepheshe wezempilo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.52: Ukubuya kwesikhathi ngemva kokubeletha kusho ukuthi isikhathi sakho siyabuya ngemva kokubeletha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.55: Ukubhala izinsuku kungakusiza ulandelele indlela umjikelezo wakho ushintsha ngayo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.56: Okuqukethwe kungolwazi. Izikhathi zingahluka ngokuya ngesimo ngasinye futhi azithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha.
